title: Alps road trip
subtitle: Twelve provisional nights in the Alps
headline: Alps road trip
lede: A fictional family road trip used as a sample. Several stays and the return flight are still open, so validate_trip.py can show timeline gaps and a BOOK FIRST list.
dietary_note: Riley and Ama eat gluten-free. diet_fit is judged against the union (gluten-free).

dates.note: Provisional window around mid-June. Exact days can move by a few nights.

travelers.name: Ama Okonkwo
travelers.gear: Booster seat for the rental car.

overview_notes: Destinations still open (dates and lodging are provisional): annecy.

pace.hotel_changes: two or three bases, not a new hotel every night

lodging.notes: A well-equipped apartment is preferred when travelling with a child.

transport.notes: Rental car collected at Geneva. International driving permit to be confirmed.

already_booked_notes: Only the outbound flight is booked. The return, the rental car, and every stay are still open.

entry_checks.visa: For this sample party (British passports, short stays in France and Italy / Schengen): confirm current entry rules on official UK and destination-government pages. This note is illustrative.
entry_checks.passport_validity: Look up the current Schengen validity rule (often three months beyond departure from the area). Children's passports follow the same check. Sample only.
entry_checks.insurance: Travel medical insurance is strongly recommended. A rental car needs its own cover, including a child booster seat policy.
entry_checks.power_adapters: France and Italy use Type C and Type F (Italy also Type L in some buildings), 230 V / 50 Hz. A compact C/F/L set covers both countries.

problem_dates.note: Early summer is high season in the valley. Lodging books out; this is why the unbooked stays are on BOOK FIRST.

entry_checks.notes: Illustrative research for a fictional sample trip.
